context.description: Slug of the bounded context that owns the service this schema belongs to. Defaults to the name of the input directory.

service.description: Slug of the service the schema describes. Defaults to the name of the input directory.

schema.description: The schema, relative to the input root: one .graphql document, or a directory of them read together. Left out, the extractor looks for them.

api.description: Prefix for the ids of the interfaces this produces. Left out, it is the service and a major version: bff gives bff.v1, and a module called basket gives bff.v1.Basket.

out.description: Name of the fragment file, inside the step's output directory.
